title: Image Renderer
description: Displays a 2D texture or a cropped spritesheet region on an entity. Use Image Renderer for characters, props, backgrounds, and UI images.

blocks.content: The **Image Renderer** component draws an imported image asset (**.png**, **.jpg**, or **.webp**) inside the bounds of an entity's [Transform & UI Transform](components/transform). It includes an interactive crop modal for slicing individual frames out of a spritesheet and supports both crisp pixel art and smooth filtering.

items.title: Interactive Crop
items.desc: Click the preview thumbnail to slice spritesheets with grid snapping.

items.title: Pixel & Smooth Modes
items.desc: Switch between **Pixelated** filtering for retro art and **Smooth** filtering for HD graphics.

items.title: SDF Rendering
items.desc: Turn on **SDF** for sharp edges when scaling icons and silhouettes.

items.title: Animator Ready
items.desc: Pair with [Sprite Animator](components/sprite_animator) for frame-by-frame animation clips.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Image Renderer**.
In the **Assets** panel of the bottom dock, right-click an image asset and choose **Apply to SpriteRenderer** (or click the **Texture** box in the inspector to pick an asset).

blocks.message: Right-click a **World** or **User Interface** layer in the **Scene Hierarchy**, hover over **Add Entity** (or **Add UI Element**), and click **Sprite** (or **UI Image**) to create an entity with **Image Renderer** already attached.

rows: 52x52 preview box on the left. Click it to open the interactive sprite crop modal.
Pixel rectangle sampled from the source texture (**X**, **Y** offset and **W**, **H** size).
Texture sampling filter: **Pixelated** (nearest-neighbor for pixel art) or **Smooth** (bilinear for high-resolution art).
Enables Signed Distance Field rendering for sharp edges at any scale.

blocks.content: Click the 3-dots icon in the **Image Renderer** header to access size and component actions.

rows: Resets **Source Rect** to the full texture and resizes the entity's transform width and height to match the image's pixel dimensions.
Available on [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs) instances. Reverts sprite settings to the master prefab.

blocks.content: Use the interactive crop modal to slice a single frame or prop from a larger spritesheet.

items: Assign a spritesheet texture to your entity's **Image Renderer**.
In the **Image Renderer** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click the 52x52 **Crop Thumbnail**.
In the crop modal toolbar, set **Snap** to your tile size (**16px**, **32px**, or **64px**).
Drag the crop handles around the desired sprite frame, or nudge the box with the **Arrow Keys**.
Press **Enter** or click **Done**. The sprite crops to that region and the entity's transform size updates proportionally.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Rendering & Camera](node_library/game_renderer) and [Animation](node_library/game_animation) to modify sprites or animate effects at runtime.

rows: Reads texture asset, source crop coordinates, opacity, or filter settings from an entity.
Changes the texture asset, crop rectangle, or opacity at runtime.
Smoothly animates the sprite opacity over a duration.
Animates the sprite **Source Rect** coordinates over time.
Crops the sprite from 0% to 100% for health bars, progress bars, and cooldown radial or directional wipes.
**Image Renderer** is locked with **Controlled by Animator**
An active [Sprite Animator](components/sprite_animator) overrides the texture and crop region every frame. Set **Status** to **Disabled** in **Sprite Animator** to edit **Image Renderer** manually.
**Sprite Animator** requires **Image Renderer**. Remove **Sprite Animator** first, then remove **Image Renderer**.
Pixel art looks blurry when scaled up
Set **Rendering** to **Pixelated** and make sure **SDF** is turned off.
